title: Canton change for the tax office
goal: When an employee moves to a different Swiss canton, HR gets the new canton to report to the tax office. The employee is not asked for it when the move stays in the same canton or goes abroad.
context: HR first said only the address is needed (F-TR-013) but later corrected this: for a move to another canton, the new canton is needed for the tax office (F-TR-014, F-TR-015). Knowing whether the canton changed requires the previous canton (F-TR-016). Under data minimisation, the employee should not be asked for it if HR already has it on record (G-01, OQ-02). There is a logical gap: you cannot tell whether the canton changed without knowing the new canton. This blocking question (OQ-01) must be answered with HR before this feature can be finalised, which is why it comes last.

stories.title: New canton for the tax office when the canton changes
stories.i_want: to receive the employee's new canton whenever they move to a different Swiss canton
stories.so_that: I can report the change of canton to the tax office
stories.priority_reason: HR explicitly corrected their first statement to add this requirement; without the new canton HR cannot fulfil its reporting duty to the tax office (F-TR-014, F-TR-015).

acceptance_criteria.title: New canton is asked only for moves within Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a change of address
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked for the new canton; for a move abroad the new canton is not asked. Whether it is asked for every move within Switzerland or only after the employee confirms a change of canton is pending the blocking open question OQ-01; until then it is asked for every move within Switzerland.

acceptance_criteria.title: A change of canton is recognised and makes the new canton required
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a change of address
acceptance_criteria.when: the move is within Switzerland and the new canton differs from the previous canton
acceptance_criteria.then: the move counts as a change of canton and the new canton must be given; if the move stays in the same canton, or goes abroad, it is not a change of canton and the new canton is not required (F-TR-013 'only the address' is superseded by F-TR-014).

examples.name: Move abroad - no change of canton

acceptance_criteria.title: HR receives the new canton on a change of canton
acceptance_criteria.given: a reported move counts as a change of canton
acceptance_criteria.then: HR receives the new canton so it can be reported to the tax office; when there is no change of canton, nothing about the canton is passed on for the tax office.

stories.title: Previous canton known to decide whether the canton changed
stories.i_want: to know the employee's previous canton for every move within Switzerland, taken from our records where possible
stories.so_that: I can tell whether the move is to a different canton and the tax office must be informed
stories.priority_reason: The change-of-canton decision that feeds the tax office report cannot be made without it (F-TR-016).

acceptance_criteria.title: Previous canton is needed only for moves within Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a change of address
acceptance_criteria.then: the previous canton must be known, from HR's records or from the employee; for a move abroad it is not asked.

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee is not asked for a previous canton HR already has
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee moves within Switzerland and HR's records already show their current canton
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is not asked for the previous canton and HR's recorded canton is used. Whether the previous canton comes from HR's records at all is still open (OQ-02); this criterion is to be confirmed with HR.

stories.title: No canton questions when they are not needed
stories.i_want: to be asked about cantons only when my move makes it necessary
stories.so_that: I do not give more personal information than HR needs
stories.priority_reason: Data minimisation and convenience for the employee (G-01); HR said explicitly the canton is not needed within the same canton (F-TR-014).

acceptance_criteria.title: Moving abroad: no canton questions
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a move abroad
acceptance_criteria.when: the new country is not Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked neither for the previous canton nor for the new canton, and the move does not count as a change of canton.

acceptance_criteria.title: Moving within the same canton: new canton not required
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee moves within Switzerland and stays in the same canton
acceptance_criteria.then: they do not have to give a new canton for the tax office. Whether they are shown the new canton question at all in this case depends on the blocking open question OQ-01.
